Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
if i Exile my own vampire, do i burn an Orun? it becomes undirected if
i direct it to myself/my controlled region, therefore not triggering
Orun's self-burning clause, correct?

so i can drop 1 Orun on an older vampire, Exile my filled-up 2 cap
Laibon (or 1 cap Bamba), and bring out said 2 cap (or Bamba) in my
influence to get to search my library?

Exile
Type: Action
Requires: Presence
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action.
[pre] (D) Tap an ally or younger vampire and untap this acting
vampire.
[PRE] (D) Tap X Orun on this vampire to send a vampire or imbued with
capacity or cost 2X or less to his or her owner's uncontrolled region.

Rarity: EK:C

Orun
Type: Master
Master: trifle.
Put this card on a Laibon. For non-Orun cards played by Methuselahs
other than this Laibon's controller, this Laibon is considered to have
2 additional capacity. A Laibon gets an additional vote for every
three Orun he or she has. If this Laibon successfully bleeds for more
than 2 or successfully performs a (D) action against a non-mortal
minion, he or she burns one Orun. Burn this card if this Laibon has
more Orun and Aye than his or her capacity.

Rarity: LoB:C EK:CΩ

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Azel wrote:
> if i Exile my own vampire, do i burn an Orun? it becomes undirected if
> i direct it to myself/my controlled region, therefore not triggering
> Orun's self-burning clause, correct?

Correct. It is not a (D) action, so Orun doesn't care.

On Oct 24, 3:44 pm, FVicentini <felix_vicent...@gmx.net> wrote:
> influence daughter , minion tap, use the concert tour , get the
> daughter back into the uncontrolled with exile and then recoup the the
> pool with memorys fading glimpse? insidious!

Memory's Fading Glimpse targets your prey's uncontrolled minions and
gives your prey pool. Just tap, tour, rinse, repeat. It's simpler
and works.

Brent Ross
